verdict.rationale: Airweave is a data-integration/search backend designed to be queried by external AI agents (via MCP, API, CLI, skills) — it is not itself a product with an embedded assistant UI that end-users delegate tasks to inside the product. The 'agentic search' feature (docs-4, docs-17) is a retrieval strategy, not a built-in assistant, so this axis is a category mismatch for this kind of infrastructure product.
